Eggs: From boiled yam with egg sauce to poached eggs on garlic yoghurt, explore how different kitchens cook the same ingredient.

copper-ladle-breakfast-club.name: Sunny-Side Eggs on Toast
copper-ladle-breakfast-club.description: Two eggs fried on one side until the whites set, with golden yolks left intact for the toast.

copper-ladle-breakfast-club.name: Nigerian Egg Roll
copper-ladle-breakfast-club.description: A whole boiled egg in a thick coat of lightly sweet dough, fried until golden and cut in half to serve.

copper-ladle-breakfast-club.name: Yaji Steak & Eggs
copper-ladle-breakfast-club.description: Griddled beef with a dusting of yaji and fried eggs. The yolks make a sauce for the sliced steak.

the-burger-house.name: Over-Easy Eggs & Ham
the-burger-house.description: The eggs get a quick flip to set the tops of the whites, then slide onto the plate beside griddled ham.

the-burger-house.name: Classic Eggs Benedict
the-burger-house.description: Poached eggs and ham on toasted muffin halves, finished with a spoonful of lemony hollandaise.

the-burger-house.name: Paprika Deviled Eggs
the-burger-house.description: Hard-boiled egg halves filled with their own yolks, mustard and mayonnaise, then dusted with paprika.

the-burger-house.name: New York Strip Steak
the-burger-house.description: The strip loin develops a dark crust on the griddle while its strip of fat crisps at the edge.

the-burger-house.name: Porterhouse Steak for Two
the-burger-house.description: A thick porterhouse sliced around the bone so two people can share both the strip and the broad tenderloin.

the-burger-house.name: Southern Chicken-Fried Steak
the-burger-house.description: Tenderised beef, not chicken: the steak is crumbed, fried crisp and served beneath peppered cream gravy.

atelier-du-soir.name: Soft Scrambled Eggs on Toast
atelier-du-soir.description: Eggs folded slowly over low heat into small, glossy curds and spooned over toast.

atelier-du-soir.name: Hanger Steak with Shallots
atelier-du-soir.description: Onglet, the deeply flavoured hanger cut, seared quickly and served with shallots softened in pan juices.

saffron-room.name: Soft-Boiled Egg & Soldiers
saffron-room.description: A soft-boiled egg served upright with slim fingers of toast for dipping into the yolk.

saffron-room.name: Scotch Egg with Mustard
saffron-room.description: A whole egg wrapped in sausage meat, coated in crumbs and fried, with mustard for dipping.

saffron-room.name: Masala Egg Bhurji
saffron-room.description: Soft scrambled eggs tossed with onion, tomato, chilli and coriander, with bread for scooping.

saffron-room.name: Flat Iron Steak with Cumin Butter
saffron-room.description: A shoulder cut seared flat on the grill, sliced into strips and finished with toasted cumin butter.

kumo-table.name: Hard-Boiled Quail Eggs
kumo-table.description: Bite-sized quail eggs served peeled, with a small dish of sesame salt on the side.

cumin-copper.name: Shakshuka Baked Eggs
cumin-copper.description: Eggs nestle in a skillet of reduced tomato and sweet pepper sauce spiced with cumin.

sumac-ember.name: Çılbır Poached Eggs
sumac-ember.description: Poached eggs over garlicky yoghurt, with warm red pepper butter running into the yolks.

sakura-house.name: Tamagoyaki Rolled Egg Omelette
sakura-house.description: Thin sheets of lightly sweetened egg are rolled together in the pan and sliced to show their layers.

sakura-house.name: Beef Tataki Steak with Ponzu
sakura-house.description: Beef seared on the outside, cooled and sliced thinly, then dressed with citrus ponzu.

spice-garden.name: Plantain & Egg Frittata
spice-garden.description: Ripe plantain rounds sit on a baked egg base with diced onion and peppers. Served in thick wedges.

the-garri-bowl.name: Boiled Yam & Egg Sauce
the-garri-bowl.description: Slices of white yam with eggs folded into a tomato, onion and fresh pepper sauce.

maison-laurent.name: Eggs en Cocotte
maison-laurent.description: Eggs gently baked in a buttered ramekin with cream; toast is served alongside to catch the last spoonful.

maison-laurent.name: Filet Mignon Steak
maison-laurent.description: A tender centre-cut beef fillet, pan-seared and butter-basted, served on smooth mashed potatoes.

olive-salt.name: Spanish Potato & Egg Tortilla
olive-salt.description: Thin slices of potato held together with egg in a thick omelette, cut into wedges for the table.

olive-salt.name: Seared Tuna Steak
olive-salt.description: A thick cut of tuna takes a quick sear on the grill and a squeeze of lemon, with a baked potato alongside.

red-pepper-courtyard.name: Egg Foo Young
red-pepper-courtyard.description: Eggs, sliced vegetables and bean sprouts fried into tender patties with browned edges.

tamarind-soi.name: Crisp Duck Egg with Basil Squid
tamarind-soi.description: A duck egg with a lacy fried edge tops rice and basil-scented squid. Break the yolk over the hot grains.

ember-court.name: Charcoal T-Bone Steak
ember-court.description: Strip loin and tenderloin meet on opposite sides of the T-shaped bone. Grilled over charcoal and carved at the table.

ember-court.name: Long-Bone Tomahawk Steak
ember-court.description: A bone-in ribeye grilled over embers, rested whole and sliced across the eye for sharing.

ember-court.name: Sea Salt Picanha Steak
ember-court.description: Rump cap grilled with its layer of fat intact and sliced across the grain, with coarse salt at the table.

ember-court.name: Pepper-Crusted Rump Steak
ember-court.description: Lean rump steak pressed into cracked pepper before grilling, with a spoonful of pan juices.

casa-verde.name: Skirt Steak with Green Herb Sauce
casa-verde.description: A thin skirt steak grilled over high heat and sliced against the grain, with a sharp herb dressing.

maiz-de-patio.name: Citrus-Grilled Flank Steak
maiz-de-patio.description: Flank steak takes a citrus marinade before grilling; thin slices are served with warm tortillas.

cortile-rosso.name: Florentine T-Bone Steak
cortile-rosso.description: A thick bistecca alla fiorentina cooked over coals, seasoned simply and carved off the bone for sharing.

lemon-quay.name: Rosemary Lamb Leg Steak
lemon-quay.description: A lamb leg steak brushed with rosemary and olive oil, charred at the edges and served with lemon.
